pr_title: Tighten osu! ruleset lifetime expiry for past hitobjects
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/10857

Doing this local to the osu! ruleset for now to see how it feels, if any problems come up, and how others feel about this with the expectation that this is to be moved into `DrawableHitObject` in the future.
pr_comments:
I'm fine with this source and this is definitely an improvement, but something is not 100% right with nested elements still on rewind - [see video](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13Rx2pnDyuLO_HJPPuD7q5Sk3i_vs49Ee/view?usp=sharing). Sometimes the nested elements (sliderhead circles, repeats, etc.) come back and then play correctly forwards again, but sometimes not. Sliderheads are definitely the worst of this as they sometimes require to go back tens of beats before they play forwards correctly again.

I haven't looked at what might the cause be - I'm not saying this is a problem with this PR, but I figured I'd point this out.
@bdach i think this is the same thing i mentioned recently in discord. will open an issue to cover it, because it is apparently a different issue.
This definitely needs to be moved to a non-ruleset specific location is we decide to do this, but let's see how things go.

issue_context.title: After seeking far into the future in non-frame-stable contexts, previous hitobjects remain alive
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
In the editor, you can sometimes select previous objects that are a very long time back (no longer on screen + multiple combos ago). I have no idea what causes this.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
https://streamable.com/cqepx3

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.1114.0

**Logs:**
[database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5544183/database.log)
[network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5544184/network.log)
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5544185/performance.log)
[performance-audio.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5544186/performance-audio.log)
[performance-draw.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5544187/performance-draw.log)
[performance-update.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5544188/performance-update.log)
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5544190/runtime.log)
comments:
This is a known issue and happened ever before pooling. Reproduction is easy on a long beatmap: seek forward far into the future and it'll be in this state.

The cause is lifetimes not correctly getting set in non-frame-stable contexts (when time moves too fast). I don't think we have an existing issue tracking this so I'll leave this open and milestone it.
I think there is an additional issue here with depth ordering in the editor post-pooling. Will look into it myself.

review_comments: we already do very similar to this in scrolling containers right?

Nah, scrolling containers also rely on the hitobjects to expire, because it is/used to be hard for them to tell when the appropriate expiry time should be.
They’ll need something similar though.
